You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

picks.reason: The strong result with 3-phenylisoxazole makes the related 3-methylisoxazole a useful test of whether a smaller C3 substituent retains the benefit.
This C3-substituted isoxazole probes whether a more electron-rich substituent can improve on the best-performing C3-phenyl additive.
The isoxazole-3-carboxylate tests a compact electron-withdrawing C3 substituent while retaining the favored ligand and base.
This 4-carboxylate is a useful positional comparison to the successful 4-phenylisoxazole additive.
The fused benzisoxazole tests whether a rigid, extended isoxazole additive can preserve the strong performance seen with phenylisoxazoles.
